_source: Live public prod catalogue GET https://api.underdogexchange.com/markets?type=single_leg&status=open, 2026-09-29 ~10:45Z, verbatim rows trimmed to four fields: every market of one event per newly listed league (FIFA international friendly AND@LTU, ARGNAC ALL@MOR, BRASILA RBB@ATL, NHL BOS@MIN) plus the ANA@VGK NHL winners. SAUDIPRO had no open market at capture time. optic_fixtures: rs-marketmaking opticodds_us.opticodds_fixtures (latest row per id). Sentence order is away-first for FIFA/NHL and HOME-first for ARGNAC/BRASILA (like UNL), so the ticker blob order never picks a side.
